selectionRule: Continue Noble-first records in dataset order. Class is a route, not ownership.

currentExecution.baselineInstruction: Replace this placeholder with the successful commit returned after 12B-NOBLE-08 execution before applying this tranche. Do not infer a SHA.

revisionLog.title: Scavenger resources removal
revisionLog.ruling: Remove resources from primary, all, and phase12b curated primary; make no other Scavenger semantic change.

revisionLog.title: Kiffu Guardian semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: The prior profile over-weighted command/leadership from Respected Officer. The Enforcement identity is fundamentally investigator/quarry-apprehension oriented; command is not identity-defining.

revisionLog.title: Ace Pilot semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: Promotes evasion to identity-defining. Ace Pilot should not be semantically identical to generic Pilot at the primary layer; its defining published expression is outmaneuvering and surviving dogfights.

revisionLog.title: Slicer Droid semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: Removes self_repair, which was not supported by the selected mechanics. Ion Resistance directly supports ion instead.

revisionLog.title: Electronic Warfare Specialist semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: Sensors remains characteristic but was too specific to be primary from the selected evidence. Removes generic support, which was not directly established by the signature package.

revisionLog.title: Clawdite Facechanger Operative semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: Shapeshifting/disguise is already captured by infiltration. manipulation is valid as a secondary social-influence signal but was too broad as a primary identity tag.

revisionLog.title: Herglic Free Trader semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: The prior profile was an exact duplicate of Free Trader. Herglic free-trader identity has source-backed exploration, mercantile-network, social-contact, and sturdy/risk-taking differentiation; this is not arbitrary uniqueness.

revisionLog.title: Zygerrian Corsair semantic QA correction
revisionLog.ruling: Adds control as a supporting identity signal for the coercive/slaving corsair expression; preserves the pirate-captain overlap without leaving the Zygerrian expression nearly indistinguishable.

curationRules: Narrative identity defines what the archetype is.
Signature exact mechanics show how that identity is expressed.
Supporting mechanics reinforce but do not automatically define identity.
Only the frozen 190-tag ontology may be used.
Class is a route, not ownership.
Parent tags do not automatically inherit to specializations.
Recommended feat/talent tags are evidence, not a bag of tags to copy wholesale.
Optional routes stay supporting unless the archetype itself requires them.
